messages:
Ravi: Hey folks — planning a quick couch co-op / console night tomorrow in the kitchenette lounge. Anyone have an HDMI switch + spare Joy-Con or PS4 pad to lend?
Kim: I have a 3-in HDMI switch and a USB-C->HDMI adapter. Can bring both.
Noah: I can bring a PS4 controller (wired) and a 2m ethernet cable.
Zoe: Ill bring snacks (granola bars) and a power strip. Also have a Switch Pro I can lend.
Ravi: Amazing, thank you! ops-bot: Room "Kitchenette Lounge" reserved by Ravi 18:30-22:30 tomorrow.
Kim: ETA 18:15 to set up. Quick poll: who wants Mario Kart / Smash / co-op indie? React with emoji.
Noah: MK + co-op.
Zoe: Smash + MK.
Ravi: Co-op warm-up then MK bracket at 8pm. If anyone wants to test wired before event: set Wi-Fi to guest-ssid and use static IP e.g. 192.168.50.60.
Noah: Heads-up: my PS4 controller needs the dongle for wireless; Ill bring cable instead.
Kim: Ill also bring an HDMI cable 1.5m.
Ravi: Perfect. Thanks all — see you tomorrow :party_popper:
